acquisition: Ordinary public Census UI: More Tools > Download > ZIP > 2024 ACS 5-Year Estimates Subject Tables > Download ZIP. No API credentials or bypass.
activation: NOT USED FOR FITTING; frozen v3 and existing population comparison inputs unchanged
candidate_population: Native C02 plus Foreign-born Naturalized citizen C04; proposed resident citizens25+, not yet independently reviewed for ANES target alignment
dataset_universe: U.S. resident population and housing; subgroup and section universes differ. Data notes include group quarters.
download_filename_timestamp: 2026-11-03T054417 local America/New_York; filename is a local download receipt, not a source publication timestamp
geography: 52 state-level rows:50 states,DC,Puerto Rico; future mainland-region analysis must explicitly exclude PR rather than silently drop rows
limitations: age percentages are rounded, so multiplying by total produces derived approximate counts, not published exact subgroup counts
education percentage denominators differ from age percentages; verify before any conversion
90 percent MOEs available; covariance and nonsampling error not provided by simple margins
citizenship alignment cannot alone certify representative synthetic profiles, joint associations or model behavior
rights: Official U.S. Census aggregate public statistical table; retain Census attribution and methodology notes. No respondent microdata.
